name: Odine Solutins Teknolji Ticrt ve Snyi AS
summary: Odine Solutions Teknoloji Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S., headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, specializes in delivering software solutions throughout the country. Their portfolio features Odine Orion for voice management, in addition to Odine Nebula, a platform for voice cloud management, and Odine Nebula+, a versatile hybrid voice platform. The company further provides Odine Gatekeeper to address voice fraud and Odine Pathfinder, a solution for centralized routing server operations.
